note: The due dates of the net profits return and of the employer returns were not stated on the city's pages; they are in its yearly due-dates notice.

items.title: File the Lexington net profits license fee return
items.authority: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government Division of Revenue
items.description: Every business entity, including sole proprietors unless the IRS has issued a tax-exempt determination letter, files a net profits license fee return (Form 228) each year and pays the occupational license fee of 2.25% of net profits. The $100 annual minimum is paid with the return, except that individuals and sole proprietors with gross receipts of $4,400 or less owe no minimum for that year and the next but must still file.
items.deadline: On the due date the city publishes each year for Form 228

items.title: Withhold and remit the Lexington occupational license fee on wages
items.authority: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government Division of Revenue
items.description: Employers withhold the 2.25% occupational license fee from employees' compensation and file the Employer's Return of License Fee Withheld each quarter, or each month once the fee withheld in any quarter exceeds $300. An annual reconciliation of the fee withheld is also filed.
items.deadline: Quarterly (monthly above $300 withheld in a quarter), plus an annual reconciliation

items.title: File Louisville Metro occupational license tax net profits return (OL-3)
items.description: Entities with business nexus in Louisville/Jefferson County pay the occupational license tax (2.2% resident rate) on net profits; due the 15th day of the 4th month after fiscal year end.

items.title: Register for and withhold Louisville occupational license tax (W-1)
items.description: Employers register with the Revenue Commission and withhold occupational license tax from employee compensation.
